'''Herf''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. A member of the [[Esral'sa'Nikto/Legends|Esral'sa'Nikto]] [[Species/Legends|subspieces]], Herf had [[Color/Legends|green-grey]] skin and gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Like all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] that the Infinite Empire enslaved, Herf was named after a letter in the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet&mdash;namely, the letter [[Herf/Legends|Herf]]&mdash;and had white [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] of the letter on the their forehead and [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. Herf was brood mates with fellow enslaved individuals [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] and [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]], and all three were among those who were used to power the machines of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species that ruled the Infinite Empire.<ref name="DOTJ 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Herf appeared in a flashback in [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]], the first issue of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''The Prisoner of Bogan'']] story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was authored by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="DOTJ 6" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[November 28]], [[2012]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/19-803/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-The-Prisoner-of-Bogan-1|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—The Prisoner of Bogan #1}}</ref>
